subject: Request: Sandbox fund extension for SmallBiz pilot throughput validation
messages:
From: Sophie Lang <sophie@brandscale.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.inference>
Cc: BrandScale Ops <ops@brandscale.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot request — extra sandbox credits for throughput run

Hi Lauren,

Hope you’re well. Quick ask from our engineering team — we’re kicking off a small-business pilot this coming weekend and want to run a focused throughput/latency validation to confirm our SLA assumptions before customer-facing rollout. The planned tests are roughly:~

- 8–10 hour sustained window (night run)
- Peak concurrency ~1200 RPS equivalent (inference-heavy)
- Expected token volume ~1.2M tokens across the run
- Latency targets: p95 < 220ms, p99 < 320ms

We’re almost out of the trial quota and would like to request a temporary sandbox fund extension (approx +150k token credit) and an extra 24–48h trial extension for this run. Attached is the test plan (smallbiz_throughput_plan.pdf) and our recent quota usage (trial_quota_history.csv).

Can Redwood approve a short-term supplement and confirm any rate or concurrency limits we should be aware of? If helpful, we can provide a short mutual action plan for the weekend.

Thanks — Sophie
Sophie Lang
Head of ML Infrastructure | BrandScale
